title: RecipeLife
description: Small Life of quality of mod that adds/changes some crafting recipes
body:
A small mod made for changing some vanilla crafting recipes to a more early-game friendly recipes on top of adding other useful crafting recipes.

New recipes include:

- Nametag crafting recipe
- Wool to string crafting recipe
- Cobblestone - Stone - Smoothstone converting by using 4 of each to upgrade.
- Nametag to individual components.
